inputs.name: homepage_version
inputs.description: Tag of the Homepage image, such as "v2.7.0". Change image_digest with it.

inputs.name: image_digest
inputs.description: Digest of the image for homepage_version, such as "sha256:19c5...". Podman pulls by the digest, so a tag that moves upstream can't change what runs.

inputs.name: image_repository
inputs.description: Where to pull Homepage's image from, without a tag.

inputs.name: listen_address
inputs.description: Address Homepage listens on. The default keeps it on the host for a reverse proxy in front; "0.0.0.0" listens on every address.

inputs.name: allowed_hosts
inputs.description: Host names, with a port where people type one, that Homepage answers to, such as ["home.example.com"]. It refuses any other Host header with a 400. The address it listens on is always allowed.

inputs.name: settings
inputs.description: settings.yaml: a map, such as { title = "Home", theme = "dark" }, or the file's YAML as a string. See https://gethomepage.dev/configs/settings/.

inputs.name: services
inputs.description: services.yaml: a list of groups, each a map of a group name to its services, or the file's YAML as a string. See https://gethomepage.dev/configs/services/.

inputs.name: bookmarks
inputs.description: bookmarks.yaml: a list of groups, or the file's YAML as a string. See https://gethomepage.dev/configs/bookmarks/.

inputs.name: widgets
inputs.description: widgets.yaml: the information widgets along the top, as a list, or the file's YAML as a string. The default is Homepage's own sample. See https://gethomepage.dev/widgets/.

inputs.name: environment
inputs.description: More of Homepage's environment variables, such as { HOMEPAGE_VAR_PROXMOX_PASSWORD = "..." }, which the config files can use as {{HOMEPAGE_VAR_PROXMOX_PASSWORD}}. They go in a root-only env file and never reach the plan or state.
